comparison.objective: Shear a racked, wet-jointed face frame until its diagonals match, then release it; candidate tunes and locks a robot-axis damper from observed impact behavior.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests coordinated opposed forces that deform a four-bar frame while keeping it flat and in bounds. Candidate tests small-tool engagement, collar adjustment, counterholding, relocking, physical control actuation, and iterative dynamic diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires diagonal difference ≤2 mm, frame retained inside its outline, no excessive lift or joint opening, and stability after both grippers retreat. Candidate requires two repeatable safe impact stops without bottoming, overload, excessive rebound, or setting drift.
comparison.reason: The tested abilities are compliant frame squaring versus tool-mediated commissioning of an adjustable dissipative mechanism; bimanual force control is only a generic shared primitive.
